posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
rajyalakshmi:

While executing my BPT2_problem_3 it shows database error.

No that is just part of your script’s output and expected output, that is not an issue. The issue is the time being different in expected output and actual output (off by one second).

It is due to the script being executed a fraction of a second after the current time was captured by the evaluator. Nice find!
It usually will not happen, unless the script is ran at a very exact time near the end of a second. And as you mentioned, re-running the script solves the issue.

If you got Evaluation successful then rest assured.
